asset_requirement.data_instruction: Include raster, ISI histogram, and summary metric panel.

figures.python_code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

spike_times = {
    "trial 1": [10, 24, 38, 53, 67],
    "trial 2": [8, 29, 37, 58, 66],
}
isi_values = {
    label: [b - a for a, b in zip(times[:-1], times[1:])]
    for label, times in spike_times.items()
}
summary = {
    label: {
        "spikes": len(times),
        "rate_hz": len(times) / 0.08,
        "mean_isi": float(np.mean(isi_values[label])),
        "cv": float(np.std(isi_values[label]) / np.mean(isi_values[label])),
    }
    for label, times in spike_times.items()
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.4, 5.8))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(
    2,
    2,
    height_ratios=[1.05, 1.0],
    width_ratios=[1.45, 0.85],
    hspace=0.52,
    wspace=0.34,
)
ax_raster = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_hist = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_summary = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
styles = {
    "trial 1": {"color": "#111827", "linewidth": 2.2},
    "trial 2": {"color": "#6b7280", "linewidth": 2.2},
}

for row, (label, times) in enumerate(spike_times.items(), start=1):
    ax_raster.vlines(
        times,
        row - 0.32,
        row + 0.32,
        colors=styles[label]["color"],
        linewidth=styles[label]["linewidth"],
    )
    ax_raster.text(72, row, f"{len(times)} spikes", va="center", fontsize=10)
ax_raster.set_xlim(0, 80)
ax_raster.set_ylim(0.4, 2.6)
ax_raster.set_yticks([1, 2])
ax_raster.set_yticklabels(["trial 1", "trial 2"])
ax_raster.set_xlabel("time (ms)")
ax_raster.set_ylabel("repeated trial")
ax_raster.set_title("Spike trains: rate, interval, and variability")
ax_raster.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

bins = [0, 10, 15, 20, 25]
ax_hist.hist(
    [isi_values["trial 1"], isi_values["trial 2"]],
    bins=bins,
    histtype="step",
    linewidth=2.2,
    color=[styles["trial 1"]["color"], styles["trial 2"]["color"]],
    label=["trial 1 ISIs", "trial 2 ISIs"],
)
ax_hist.set_xlabel("interspike interval, ISI (ms)")
ax_hist.set_ylabel("count")
ax_hist.set_xticks(bins)
handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=styles["trial 1"]["color"], linewidth=2.2, label="trial 1 ISIs"),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=styles["trial 2"]["color"], linewidth=2.2, label="trial 2 ISIs"),
]
ax_hist.legend(handles=handles, frameon=False, fontsize=9)
ax_hist.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

ax_summary.axis("off")
ax_summary.set_title("summary metrics", loc="left", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
y = 0.86
for label, values in summary.items():
    ax_summary.text(0.02, y, label, color=styles[label]["color"], fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
    ax_summary.text(0.02, y - 0.14, f"rate: {values['rate_hz']:.1f} Hz", fontsize=10)
    ax_summary.text(0.02, y - 0.28, f"mean ISI: {values['mean_isi']:.1f} ms", fontsize=10)
    ax_summary.text(0.02, y - 0.42, f"CV: {values['cv']:.2f}", fontsize=10)
    y -= 0.54
plt.show()
